answer: Locks are published in lagoon, expire in ocean, and lantern lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 171 aliases hence needs 195 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3118 identities would post 2834 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
